headline: Your Master Tracker and weekly insight views are self-maintaining again — both had silently stopped updating.

items.prompt_template: Two of your generated views had quietly stopped refreshing — your Master Tracker and your weekly insight views (timeline, relationships, commitment-aging). Both are fixed and now self-maintain: the tracker rebuilds when you end a session and on your Sunday cleanup, and a new silent Weekly Insights task (Sundays 7 PM) keeps the analytical views current. Nothing for you to do — they catch up on their own. Want them refreshed right now? Say `rebuild views` for the tracker and `run insights` for the analytical views.
